items/crossbow-heavy-537.name: Crossbow, heavy
items/crossbow-heavy-537.effectSummary: Loading the heavy crossbow with its winch is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. It normally requires two hands; it can be fired, but not loaded, one-handed at -4 on attack rolls. Firing one in each hand uses the penalties for two one-handed weapons, cumulative with the one-handed firing penalty.

items/crossbow-light-538.name: Crossbow, light
items/crossbow-light-538.effectSummary: Loading the light crossbow with its lever is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity. It normally requires two hands; it can be fired, but not loaded, one-handed at -2 on attack rolls. Firing one in each hand uses the penalties for two light weapons, cumulative with the one-handed firing penalty.

items/dragons-draught-black-375.name: Dragon's Draught, Black
items/dragons-draught-black-375.effectSummary: A dragon or creature with the dragonblood subtype that drinks this draught can use its breath weapon once during the next hour as a standard action: 80-foot line, 12d4 acid, Reflex DC 24 half. Drinking a second dragon's draught before using the first discards the first draught's effect.
